<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 114

The three major celestial planes—[Heaven](/Planes.aspx?ID=41), [Nirvana](/Planes.aspx?ID=44), and [Elysium](/Planes.aspx?ID=40)—each have their own respective dragons. Empyreal dragons have a direct connection to Heaven. Using the blessings of Heaven, empyreal dragons protect others and intercede against wickedness. Empyreal dragons are wise, considerate, and compassionate. When speaking with others, empyreal dragons are patient and understanding.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Empyreal Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2942) (Creature 14), [Ancient Empyreal Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2943) (Creature 19), [Young Empyreal Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2941) (Creature 10)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Empyreal Dragon Lairs</title>

Although most empyreal dragons keep homes among the environs of heaven, many dragons also choose to keep lairs across the mortal [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26). These lairs are generally in less remote places, with the expectation being that a person would be more likely to stumble upon one and find assistance in times of need. In addition to the traditional riches of a dragon's hoard, an empyreal dragon's hoard contains a multitude of armaments, typically sized to fit the people of the region should they need equipment to face off against evil.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Empyreal Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Empyreal dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

<title level="2" right="">Young Empyreal Dragon</title> **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 29, attack +22; **4th** [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1493), [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732), [_vital beacon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1743); **3rd** [_bind undead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1449), [_ring of truth_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1656), [_sound body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1679); **2nd** [_clear mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1469), [_everlight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1518), [_share life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1669); **1st** [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1451), [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1597), [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1660); **Cantrips (4th**) [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485), [_divine lance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1498), [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1549), [_shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1671), [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1689) 

<title level="2" right="">Adult Empyreal Dragon</title> **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 34, attack +28; As young empyreal dragon, plus **6th** [_field of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1526), [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1493), [_spirit blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1685); **5th** [_breath of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1456), [_clear mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1469), [_sending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1665); **Cantrips (6th)** _detect magic_, _divine lance_, _guidance_, _shield_, _stabilize_ 

<title level="2" right="">Ancient Empyreal Dragon</title> **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 41, attack +35; As adult empyreal dragon, plus **9th** [_divine decree_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1495), [_overwhelming presence_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1621), [_sunburst_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1707); **8th** [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1493), [_divine inspiration_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1497), [_moment of renewal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1607); **7th** [_energy aegis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1512), [_planar seal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1635), [_regenerate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1648); **Cantrips (9th)** _detect magic_, _divine lance_, _guidance_, _shield_, _stabilize_
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Yssendri</title>

Originally hailing from the ranks of heaven's greatest armies, the great empyreal archdragon Yssendri eventually retired from direct combat, choosing to focus on more philanthropic ventures. They travel to smaller settlements across [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26) to aid in defending innocents. Recently, they traveled to the desert nation of Thuvia to defend a caravan of merchants from afar.
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396), [Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397), [Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398), [Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402), [Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)
